name: Fish, catfish, channel, farmed, cooked, dry heat (USDA food medium)
description: Food-derived medium from USDA FoodData Central (SR Legacy): measured amino acids, sugars, fatty acids, vitamins and minerals of Fish, catfish, channel, farmed, cooked, dry heat, plus a mineral base. Measured nutrients with no curated BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered; non-metabolite aggregates (energy, protein, total fat/fibre) are excluded by design.

provenance.citation: U.S. Department of Agriculture, FoodData Central (SR Legacy), fdc.nal.usda.gov (FDC ID 175166).
provenance.notes: USDA measured nutrients mapped to BiGG via a curated nutrient->exchange table; amounts (per 100 g) in usda_amount/usda_unit. Unmapped measured metabolites kept in uncovered (v2). Aggregates excluded.
provenance.url_status_note: USDA FoodData Central returns HTTP 404 for food-details URLs while its single-page app renders the correct food page client-side (verified 2026-09-06: curl -> 404 with an identical app shell for every id; headless Chromium -> the correct title and nutrient table). The link works for a reader and fails for a link-checker. Do not retire it.

composition_provenance.definition: sourced = the cited source states this component; derived = the pipeline supplied it. Classification table: tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all divides components by (components + unresolved ingredients). It counts pipeline-derived components as covered, so it is not a measure of how much of the source's own ingredient list was captured. pct_covered_source divides source-stated components by (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components), which is that measure. Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
